item.title: The Oura Ring 5 just got its biggest discount ever for Black Friday
item.description:
If you’ve been curious about smart rings but have been put off by their high price tags, Black Friday is a good time to consider giving one a try. That’s because the Oura Ring 5, which we consider the best smart ring you can buy, has dropped to an all-time low of $299 ($100 off) at Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, and Oura’s online storefront for Black Friday.

Oura Ring 5

Where to Buy:

  • $399 $299 at Amazon
  • $399 $299 at Walmart
  • $399 $299 at Best Buy

Compared to the Ring 4, the Oura Ring 5 offers a thinner, lighter, and more durable design that’s more comfortable to wear throughout the day and while sleeping. Like its predecessor, it can track your sleep, activity, heart rate, and other health metrics, giving you insights into your overall well-being without requiring you to constantly check a screen. It also offers roughly the same battery life and sensors as the prior model, though its new charging case supports wireless charging. (Unfortunately, the case is currently sold separately for $99.)

Oura has also introduced several new software features, including Health Radar, which looks for potentially significant changes in your health. You can also import medical lab results, track GLP-1 medications, and access AI-assisted medical guidance through Oura’s partnership with Counsel Health. My colleague Victoria Song appreciated how the latter makes it easier to connect with an actual doctor, though she found it better suited for quick medical questions than more serious health concerns.

However, none of these software features are exclusive to the Ring 5, and you’ll still need a $5.99 monthly Oura membership to access most of its health insights. Given how similar the two generations are, we wouldn’t recommend upgrading if you already own a Ring 4. But if you’re new to smart rings, the current discount makes Oura’s latest model much more attractive, especially since it’s only $50 more than the Ring 4’s starting price.

Read our full Oura Ring 5 review.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is a different kind of GTA — so it needed a different kind of ending
item.description:
In most Grand Theft Auto games, and most open-world games for that matter, the world is left open for you to explore once the credits roll. It could be Los Santos or a twisted take on Manhattan, but the idea is that the main story is just one part of the experience. After that's done, there are usually still places you haven't explored or side missions you left lingering. But Grand Theft Auto VI doesn't work quite the same way. Because of its storyline, which involves a couple trying to get out of the criminal life for good, that kind of ending didn't really fit.

item.title: Some of our favorite Sony, LG, and TCL TVs are over 50 percent off for Black Friday
item.description:
Most of us spend a lot of time with our TVs, be it watching movies, TV shows, the news, or playing games. It’s part of being a fan of technology. And while they’re big purchases, they can last for years. But eventually, the time comes when we need a new one. Has that time come for you? Black Friday sales will make it easier to find something great for a lot less than it’d usually cost.

With several different types of TVs out there, it can get confusing which ones are worth it. Are the new RGB LED TVs all they’re cracked up to be? (Sometimes.) Does OLED still deliver the best contrast available? (Yup.) Are tried-and-true LED TVs still worth it in 2026 for those on a budget? (Absolutely.) One thing you can be sure of, is any TV I recommend here is more than worth the price. If you need a TV, Black Friday is the time to buy.

TCL came out swinging early this year with its flagship X11L. It gets blazingly bright, has great color accuracy, and is now thousands of dollars cheaper than its original price. Read our review.

item.title: The absolute best Black Friday deals we’ve found (so far)
item.description:
This year’s Black Friday deals have launched in waves over the past several weeks, but now the floodgates have officially opened. You can now take advantage of the lowest prices we’ve seen in-store and online for video games, wireless earbuds, TVs, e-readers, robot vacuums, and so much more. We can’t guarantee a deal you’ve had your eye on will last through Cyber Monday; however, if prior years are any indication, most will stick around through the long holiday weekend.

As usual, we sorted through thousands of deals to find the ones truly worth sharing, with an eye for the products and services we’ve tested here at The Verge. With prices up across multiple categories due to RAMageddon, some deals may not seem as big as in prior years. For example, Apple’s latest MacBook Air recently fell to its pre-price hike level for the first time since July. That’s a deal to us, and several other discounts are taking a similar shape. We’ll provide context when possible and keep this post updated throughout the day.

item.title: The SE 3 is the Apple Watch most people should buy on Black Friday
item.description:
During Black Friday, the Apple Watch SE 3 is on sale in the 40mm / GPS configuration at Amazon, Walmart, and Target starting around $179 ($70 off), $20 less than its previous lowest price. The 44mm variant, meanwhile, is on sale at Amazon, Walmart, and Target starting at around $209 (also $70 off), also beating its previous low by $20.

Apple Watch SE 3

Where to Buy:

  • $249 $179 at Amazon (40mm, GPS)
  • $249 $179 at Walmart (40mm, GPS)
  • $279 $209 at Amazon (44mm, GPS)

Despite having launched over a year ago, the Apple Watch SE 3 is still the Apple Watch model we recommend for most people. It includes many of the trademark features of higher-end Apple Watch models like the Series 12, including an always-on display, double-tap and wrist flick gestures, fast-charging, and on-device Siri. The compromise is that the SE 3 lacks some of the more advanced health features found on more expensive models, like blood oxygen and EKG sensing. The battery life also isn’t quite as strong, but if you don’t need as many health-tracking sensors, it’s a much better value, especially at this price.

Read our Apple Watch SE 3 review.

item.title: The Garmin Forerunner 265S is down to $300, its best price of the year
item.description:
The Forerunner 265S may not be the newest or flashiest Garmin, but it’s one that I’ve always loved most in testing. For runners with smaller wrists, it fits nicely. The battery life is pretty good thanks in part to its OLED touchscreen. When I reviewed it a few years ago, I called it the Goldilocks of fitness watches at the time, and the only thing that bugged me was its price. But now that it’s down to $299.99 (a $150 discount off its MSRP) at Amazon and Best Buy for Black Friday, I can easily recommend it.

Garmin Forerunner 265S (42mm)

Garmin’s Forerunner 265S is identical to the standard 265, only it features a slightly better battery life and a smaller 42mm build for those with more petite wrists.

Where to Buy:

  • $449.99 $299.99 at Amazon
  • $449.99 $299.99 at Best Buy

The neat thing about Garmins in general is that you really don’t need the latest models to get the most out of the company’s platform. Its watches tend to get firmware updates for several years after launch, which is how long the average Garmin user tends to hold on to theirs. This particular watch is best suited for folks who want something a bit slimmer and smaller, enjoy a pop of color, and want a little extra fitness tracking prowess — but don’t need the whole kit and caboodle that sends the price up by hundreds.

There are a few other Garmin models I like that are also on sale during Black Friday. I wish that I had 10 arms to fully vet every single last one, but alas. That said, here are some others that I have tested and recommend:

  • The Garmin Fenix 8 is $749 at Amazon, Best Buy, and REI, which is a 25 percent discount off its original price. Its higher price comes down to having more features than the Forerunner 265S, so it’s really best for someone who does multiple outdoor sports and could make use of its handy LED flashlight.
  • Garmin’s Venu 4 is $449 at Amazon, Best Buy, and REI, an 18 percent discount. This is a great option if you’re looking for more of a smartwatch that does fitness than a fitness-y watch that looks like a smartwatch. It’s a fine line, but if you know, you know.
  • Finally, Garmin’s Forerunner 970 is $100 off, costing $649 at Amazon, Best Buy, and REI. This is what I’d recommend to marathoners who need something a bit more robust but not as heavy-duty as the flagship Fenix line. I’ve used it to train for a few races and it’s a solid upper-midrange (for Garmin!) option.

item.title: The MacBook Neo is receiving a rare $100 discount for Black Friday
item.description:
If you’re looking for a new laptop or a gift for the student in your life, you can save $100 on the MacBook Neo at several retailers, in both storage sizes and all four colors. The 256GB model is currently discounted to $599.99 at Amazon and Costco, while the 512GB model with Touch ID is available for $699.99 via the same retailers (Amazon / Costco). None of the retailers currently list an end date for the discount, which is the biggest price drop we’ve seen since Apple raised the laptop’s MSRP by $100 in July in response to the ongoing RAM crisis.

MacBook Neo

Where to Buy:

  • $799 $699.99 at Amazon (512GB, Touch ID)
  • $699 $599.99 at Amazon (256GB)
  • $699 $599.99 at Costco (256GB)

Apple’s budget-friendly MacBook leverages the A18 Pro processor, a chip originally found in the iPhone 16 Pro, to keep costs down. Both the 256GB and 512GB models feature 8GB of memory, and my colleague Antonio G. Di Benedetto was impressed by the vivid 13-inch screen and speakers, the latter of which are better than those in many cheap (and even midrange) Windows laptops. The Neo isn’t super performant, especially in terms of storage speed and total memory, but it’s great for everyday tasks, casual use, and students.

Read our Apple MacBook Neo review.

Update, November 26th: Adjusted pricing and availability to reflect the additional discount that’s now available at both Amazon and Costco.
